The name is also mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Kahf, where it refers to something that is curved or irregular. In Islamic tradition, the name Shazleen is considered to be a symbol of beauty and elegance, and is often associated with qualities such as flexibility and adaptability. In modern times, the name Shazleen has gained popularity across Muslim cultures and is now used by parents from diverse backgrounds.
